```{r}
#load libraries
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)
```


```{r}
#path to csv
zika_path <- "C:/Users/lucil/Desktop/Zika"

zika_files <- list.files(
  path = zika_path,
  pattern = "\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

zika_files

```

```{r}
#import files

zika <- map_dfr(
  zika_files,
  ~ read_delim(
      .x,
      delim = ",",
      col_names = TRUE,
      locale = locale(encoding = "ISO-8859-1")
    )
)

View(zika)

```

```{r}
#count numbers per year
nrow(zika)
ncol(zika)

zika %>% count(NU_ANO)

```

```{r}
zika_eda <- zika %>%
  select(
    year = NU_ANO,
    uf = SG_UF_NOT,
    municipio = ID_MUNICIP,
    class_final = CLASSI_FIN
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(year))

zika_eda %>% count(year)

```

```{r}
#plot Brazil 2026-2025

p_zika <- ggplot(zika_eda %>% count(year),
                 aes(x = year, y = n)) +
  geom_line(color = "#7570b3", linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_point(color = "#7570b3", size = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "Zika Virus Notifications in Brazil",
    subtitle = "Annual counts, 2016–2025",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of notifications"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

p_zika

```

```{r}
ggsave(
  "figures/zika_national_trend.png",
  plot = p_zika,
  width = 8,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)

```

```{r}
#Checking confirmed vs notified 
zika_confirmed <- zika_eda %>%
  filter(class_final == 1)  

zika_confirmed %>% count(year)

```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

zika_state_year <- zika_eda %>%
  count(year, uf)

zika_state_year

```

```{r}
#loading dataset with state and region names

ufs <- read_csv(
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mapaslivres/municipios-br/main/tabelas/ufs.csv"
)

glimpse(ufs)
```

```{r}

#renaming
ufs_clean <- ufs %>%
  transmute(
    uf_ibge = as.integer(uf),     # numeric IBGE UF code (12, 27, 32…)
    uf_sigla = uf_code,           # "AC", "AL", "ES", …
    uf_nome = name,               # full state name
    macroregion = macroregion     # Norte, Nordeste, etc.
  )

```

```{r}
zika_state_year <- zika_eda %>%
  mutate(uf_ibge = as.integer(uf)) %>%
  count(year, uf_ibge)

```

```{r}
zika_state_year_named <- zika_state_year %>%
  left_join(ufs_clean, by = "uf_ibge")

```

```{r}
zika_state_year_named %>%
  filter(is.na(uf_sigla)) %>%
  distinct(uf_ibge)
  
```

```{r}
#count by state
ggplot(zika_state_year_named, aes(x = year, y = n)) +
  geom_line(color = "#7570b3", linewidth = 1.05) +
  facet_wrap(~ uf_sigla, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Zika Virus Notifications by State",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of notifications"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r}
#count by region
ggplot(zika_state_year_named, aes(x = year, y = n)) +
  geom_line(color = "#7570b3", linewidth = 1.05) +
  facet_wrap(~ macroregion, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Zika Virus Notifications by Region",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of notifications"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r}
#comparison of residence vs notification

library(dplyr)

zika_location_compare <- zika %>%
  filter(!is.na(NU_ANO)) %>%
  count(
    year = NU_ANO,
    uf_notif = SG_UF_NOT,
    uf_resi  = SG_UF
  )

```

```{r}
zika_loc_summary <- zika %>%
  count(
    uf_notif = SG_UF_NOT,
    uf_resi  = SG_UF
  )

```

```{r}
#summarize by state totals
notif_totals <- zika_loc_summary %>%
  group_by(uf_notif) %>%
  summarise(notified_cases = sum(n), .groups = "drop")

resi_totals <- zika_loc_summary %>%
  group_by(uf_resi) %>%
  summarise(resident_cases = sum(n), .groups = "drop")

```

```{r}
#summarize by state totals
notif_named <- notif_totals %>%
  rename(uf_ibge = uf_notif) %>%
  left_join(ufs_clean, by = "uf_ibge")

resi_named <- resi_totals %>%
  rename(uf_ibge = uf_resi) %>%
  left_join(ufs_clean, by = "uf_ibge")

```

```{r}
#join with UF names
notif_named <- notif_totals %>%
  rename(uf_ibge = uf_notif) %>%
  left_join(ufs_clean, by = "uf_ibge")

resi_named <- resi_totals %>%
  rename(uf_ibge = uf_resi) %>%
  left_join(ufs_clean, by = "uf_ibge")

```

```{r}
zika_state_table <- notif_named %>%
  select(
    uf_sigla,
    uf_nome,
    notified_cases
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    resi_named %>%
      select(uf_sigla, resident_cases),
    by = "uf_sigla"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    difference = notified_cases - resident_cases
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(difference)))

knitr::kable(
  zika_state_table,
  caption = "Comparison of Zika cases by state of notification and state of residence"
)

```

```{r}


zika_state_table_pretty <- notif_named %>%
  select(
    uf_sigla,
    uf_nome,
    notified_cases
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    resi_named %>%
      select(uf_sigla, resident_cases),
    by = "uf_sigla"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    difference = notified_cases - resident_cases
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(difference)))

```



```{r}
zika_state_table_pct <- zika_state_table_pretty %>%
  mutate(
    pct_difference = round(
      100 * difference / resident_cases, 2
    )
  )

knitr::kable(
  zika_state_table_pct,
  col.names = c(
    "UF",
    "State",
    "Cases (Notification)",
    "Cases (Residence)",
    "Difference",
    "% Difference"
  ),
  caption = "Comparison of Zika cases by state of notification and state of residence"
)

```
